# JPNS Enterprises LLC

A diversified enterprise spanning luxury brands, experiences, entertainment, wellness, hospitality, and philanthropy. Founded and led by Jewell Proby Shine. Motto: Strength. Vision. Legacy.

## Pages

- Home (/) — brand statement and overview of the five divisions
- About (/about) — company story, founder biography, mission, vision, values
- Divisions (/divisions) — overview of all five divisions
- Self-Care (/divisions/self-care) — Jewell's Herbal Magic Blend, a handcrafted caffeine-free herbal tea of 16 botanicals
- Events & Entertainment (/divisions/events-entertainment) — motivational speaking, event hosting, and production portfolio
- Restaurant Chains (/divisions/restaurant-chains) — turnkey dining franchise concept
- Luxury Car Rentals (/divisions/luxury-car-rentals) — exotic and luxury vehicle rentals
- Philanthropy (/divisions/philanthropy) — orphanage support, women's empowerment, and community outreach including work in Athi River, Kenya
- Impact (/impact) — community impact metrics and initiatives
- Shop (/shop) — purchase Jewell's Herbal Magic Blend
- Contact (/contact) — enquiries: info@gojpns.net, phone 678.572.2368
- Partner With Us (/partner) — partnership enquiries
